Subject: OKR mid-quarter readout & team ownership memo

Team —

As we approach the mid-quarter QBR, I wanted to kick off a short, focused thread to align on two things: (1) what we will present at the QBR as the mid-quarter readout, and (2) a clarified ownership matrix for in-flight org changes and priority bets. This is intended to keep the QBR crisp and to reduce ambiguity in follow-ups.

High-level ask (two bullets):
- By end-of-day tomorrow, please: review the attached mid-quarter slides and add one slide (max) that represents your squad’s top 2 risks + mitigation plan.
- Confirm a single owner (name + back-up) for each of the five cross-team logistical items on slide 3 (rollout cadence, model pinning, canary policy, perf regression alerts, and billing reconciliation).

Draft agenda for the leadership readout (10–12 min):
1) One-line posture update (team lead) — 90s each
2) Top OKR progress numbers vs. target (visual) — 3 min
3) Top 3 risks and mitigations — 3 min
4) Ask list & owners — 2 min

Attached: OKR_midquarter_slide_v1.pptx (editable). I also added a rough ownership_matrix_v2.xlsx to seed names. Please don’t over-polish — we want signals, not slick decks.

Notes on tone: aim for outcome-focused, candid about regressions, and explicit about decisions we expect the execs to make.

Thanks — please reply inline with owners and any objections to the agenda.

—Kimberly
